annotations.title: Get the setup steps of an integration type

description:
Get the setup steps of an integration type

Returns the steps the setup wizard in the dashboard shows for one integration type, for example where to create the key in the other app, with the link to start there (`providerSetupUrl`) and the expected setup time. Use it after `list_integration_types`, which gives the `type` and the config fields, and before `create_integration`, to guide a person to their credentials. Read only and the same for every account. `null` when there is no guide for this type.
name: get_integration_setup_guide
title: Get the setup steps of an integration type
